title: Group8_Homework2
text:
Two vectors are created corresponding to the pre-treatment and post-treatment measurements for twenty subjects.

# Create the pre-treatment blood pressure vector
pretreatment <- c(130, 128, 116, 124, 133, 134, 118, 126, 114, 127, 141, 138, 128, 140, 137, 131, 120, 128, 139, 135)

# Create the post-treatment blood pressure vector
posttreatment <- c(114, 98, 113, 99, 107, 116, 113, 111, 119, 117, 101, 119, 130, 122, 106, 106, 124, 102, 117, 113)




Subject names are assigned using the paste() function to the pre-treatment and post-treatment vectors.

#Assign subject names to pre-treatment vector
names(pretreatment) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")

#Assign subject names to post-treatment vector
names(posttreatment) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")




Calculated the change in blood pressure (pretreatment - posttreatment) and saved the calculation as a new vector.

diff_bp <- pretreatment - posttreatment




Calculated the average decrease in blood pressure across all subjects.

mean(diff_bp)

[1] 17





Determined a list of subjects that experienced a decrease in blood pressure (diff_bp>0) with treatment.

which(diff_bp>0)

 Subject_1  Subject_2  Subject_3  Subject_4  Subject_5  Subject_6  Subject_7 
         1          2          3          4          5          6          7 
 Subject_8 Subject_10 Subject_11 Subject_12 Subject_14 Subject_15 Subject_16 
         8         10         11         12         14         15         16 
Subject_18 Subject_19 Subject_20 
        18         19         20 





Subset the vector of differences to only return those that have a positive change.

positive_diff <- diff_bp[diff_bp>0]

positive_diff

 Subject_1  Subject_2  Subject_3  Subject_4  Subject_5  Subject_6  Subject_7 
        16         30          3         25         26         18          5 
 Subject_8 Subject_10 Subject_11 Subject_12 Subject_14 Subject_15 Subject_16 
        15         10         40         19         18         31         25 
Subject_18 Subject_19 Subject_20 
        26         22         22 





Calculated the average decrease in blood pressure for those subjects that had a positive change

mean(positive_diff)

title: Group8_Homework2
text:
Task 3: List Practice

1. Creating Placebo Data Frame
Pre-treatment and post-treatment blood pressure measurements from the placebo experiment are used to create a second data frame similar to the treatment data frame.

# Create placebo pre-treatment blood pressure vector
placebo_pre <- c(138, 135, 147, 117, 152, 134, 114, 121, 131, 130)

# Create placebo post-treatment blood pressure vector
placebo_post <- c(105, 136, 123, 130, 134, 143, 135, 139, 120, 124)

# Assign subject names to placebo_pre vector
names(placebo_pre) <- paste("PlaceboSubject", 1:10, sep = "_")

# Assign subject names to placebo_post vector
names(placebo_post) <- paste("PlaceboSubject", 1:10, sep = "_")

# Calculate change in blood pressure for placebo
placebo_diff_bp <- placebo_pre - placebo_post

# Create vector containing placebo subject names
placebo_patient <- names(placebo_pre)

#Combine placebo blood pressure information into a data frame
placebo_dataframe <- data.frame(
  patient = placebo_patient,
  pre_bp = placebo_pre,
  post_bp = placebo_post,
  diff_bp = placebo_diff_bp
)

# Add a TRUE/FALSE column based on post-placebo blood pressure
placebo_dataframe$post_lessThan_120 <- placebo_dataframe$post_bp < 120
